segments.en: The New Jersey discount to New York and Philadelphia, it's gone with the cost of living in the suburbs now starting to outpace that was a nation world. Yeah, absolutely. Paulina Cachero reported on the story and she joins us now in Paulina.
segments.zh: 新泽西相对纽约和费城的成本优势已经消失，郊区生活成本开始超过全国平均水平。宝琳娜·卡切罗报道了此事，现在加入我们。

segments.en: What's happening in New Jersey where costs are rising so much faster than even New York City?
segments.zh: 新泽西发生了什么，为什么成本上涨比纽约市还快？

segments.en: Yeah, so I think like from 2020 to since 2021 and during the pandemic we saw housing costs increase, right?
segments.zh: 从2020年到2021年疫情期间，我们看到住房成本上升了。

segments.en: People could suddenly work from anywhere, they wanted to move to the suburbs, have a little bit more space under COVID-19 lockdowns and we saw housing prices just expand.
segments.zh: 人们突然可以远程工作，想搬到郊区，在封锁期间有更多空间，于是住房成本就扩大了。

segments.en: Then obviously everyone came back, bosses were calling workers back to the office and everyone started moving closer along the Hudson River so they could come back into the city.
segments.zh: 后来大家回归，老板叫员工回办公室，人们开始搬到哈德逊河附近以便进城。

segments.en: And since then overall inflation has risen, New York City has gotten a lot more expensive and people that might not have moved to the suburbs started to
segments.zh: 自那以后整体通胀上升，纽约市变得更贵，原本可能不会搬到郊区的人开始……

segments.en: enlarge pardon, now childcare costs are what's driving up the cost of raising a family in New Jersey.
segments.zh: 抱歉，现在托儿费用是推高新泽西养家成本的主要因素。

segments.en: It used to be housing was cheaper in the suburbs and you got more bang for your buck there but now that's starting to equalize a little bit too.
segments.zh: 过去郊区住房更便宜，性价比更高，但现在这一点也开始趋同了。

segments.en: Yeah, especially with interest rates where they're at, if you could probably find a rental that's comparable to the cost of your mortgage in New Jersey.
segments.zh: 是的，尤其是考虑到当前利率水平，在新泽西租房成本可能和月供差不多。

segments.en: And you might be getting more space but the cost you might be saving, you're spending commuting back into the city and in the higher cost of childcare as well.
segments.zh: 你可能得到更多空间，但省下的钱要花在通勤进城和更高的托儿费用上。
